games.name: The Witcher 3

games.note: ProtonDB reports Gold with Platinum trending; test HDR, FSR and frame pacing on each release.

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.note: ProtonDB reports Gold; the Rockstar Launcher remains the risk surface.

games.name: GTA V
games.note: Story Mode runs well under Proton (ProtonDB Gold); GTA Online's BattlEye is not enabled for Linux, so online play stays unsupported.

games.name: God of War
games.note: ProtonDB reports Platinum.

games.name: Hogwarts Legacy
games.note: ProtonDB reports Gold with Platinum trending.

games.note: ProtonDB reports Platinum.

games.note: ProtonDB reports Gold with Platinum trending.

games.name: Sekiro
games.note: ProtonDB reports Platinum.

games.name: Dark Souls III
games.note: ProtonDB reports Platinum; VAC does not restrict Linux for this title.

games.name: Monster Hunter: World
games.note: ProtonDB reports Gold with Platinum trending.

games.name: Hades
games.note: ProtonDB reports Platinum.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic
games.note: EAC Linux support is enabled; ProtonDB reports Platinum.

games.name: Dead by Daylight
games.note: EAC Linux support is enabled on Steam, the recommended storefront; Epic's version is reported broken on Linux.

games.name: The Finals
games.note: EAC Linux support is enabled; ProtonDB reports Gold.

games.name: Halo Infinite
games.note: EAC Linux support is enabled; ProtonDB reports Silver, so check current reports and a recent Proton before counting on it.

games.name: Overwatch 2
games.note: Blizzard's Steam release runs under Proton (ProtonDB Platinum); the Battle.net/umu path also works.

games.name: Paladins
games.note: EAC is enabled for Linux, but Hi-Rez has said it has no Linux plans and the game is known to break after updates; ProtonDB reports Silver.

games.name: Rainbow Six Siege
games.note: Ubisoft has not enabled BattlEye for Linux and does not support Proton; ProtonDB rates it Borked.
games.source: Ubisoft BattlEye FAQ; ProtonDB; Are We Anti-Cheat Yet (2026-11-24)

games.name: Hunt: Showdown
games.note: EAC Linux support is enabled; ProtonDB reports Gold.

games.name: Warframe
games.note: EAC Linux support is enabled; ProtonDB reports Gold with Platinum trending.

games.name: Apex Legends
games.note: EA blocked Linux access in October 2024 and moved PC anti-cheat to EA Javelin on 29 September 2026; no Linux support has been announced.
games.source: EA Javelin announcement; ProtonDB; Are We Anti-Cheat Yet (2026-11-24)

games.name: Destiny 2
games.note: Bungie states SteamOS/Proton is unsupported and warns against bypass attempts; BattlEye is not enabled for Linux.
games.source: Bungie Help; Are We Anti-Cheat Yet (2026-11-24)

games.name: Rust
games.note: Facepunch has publicly said there are no current Proton/Linux support plans.
games.source: Facepunch statement coverage; Are We Anti-Cheat Yet (2026-11-24)

games.name: PUBG
games.note: BattlEye and additional anti-cheat are present and not configured for Proton; online play is unavailable on Linux.

games.name: Valorant
games.note: Riot Vanguard requires ring-0 kernel access: Windows-only driver. No Linux support from Riot.

games.name: Fortnite
games.note: Epic has not enabled Linux support for Fortnite, despite EAC supporting Linux for other games.

games.name: Call of Duty (MP/WZ)
games.note: RICOCHET anti-cheat runs at kernel level on Windows and has no Linux support.

games.name: Roblox
games.note: Roblox's Byfron/Hyperion anti-cheat blocks Wine/Proton paths; third-party runtimes are not Linux support.

games.name: League of Legends
games.note: Riot moved LoL to Vanguard in 2024 and states it does not support Linux.

games.name: Escape from Tarkov
games.note: BattlEye can support Linux, but this title has not enabled a supported Proton path; online raids are unavailable.

games.name: Lost Ark
games.note: EAC was enabled for Linux in July 2025; Proton 10 or Proton-GE 10.9 and later are recommended, and ProtonDB reports Gold.
